kappa.label: kappa
kappa.relations: kappa^2 = 0; kappa x = (-1)^{p(x)} x kappa for homogeneous x
kappa.role: odd central element of the extension A = V ⊕ CK ⊕ Cκ; carries the inhomogeneous deformation [X,Y]_γ = [X,Y]_0 + κ γ(X,Y)

K.label: K
K.role: even central element; appears as the Z-label of scalar components of γ and f

gb_matrix.description: Deformation parameters gb_{a_1^σ, b_k^s}; rows = fermions a_1^±, columns = bosons b_k^±
gb_matrix.parity_note: The product gb·kappa is the odd super-central symbol used in the computation; gb coefficients are extracted as commuting scalars (see docs/json_schema_specification.md §2).

inhomogeneous_deformation.description: [X,Y]_γ = [X,Y]_0 + kappa * γ(X,Y); γ(X,Y) ∈ g ⊕ C K with p(γ(X,Y)) = p(X)+p(Y)+1; all ordered pairs stored

references: Frappat, Sciarrino, Sorba (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
